visual_review: Before: thumb wrapped into a G-shaped hook that read as a letter, not the reference's straight thumb across the fist. After: four r4 knuckles, finger splits down to a straight thumb band ending in an r4 tip, narrowing wrist; reads as a raised fist at 48 in both themes.
omissions: Palm crease curve omitted; fourth finger split is a short stub to keep 9 from the thumb tip.
